question: What limitation is stated regarding worship of an image or even a tree?
premises: Worship of an image is mentioned.
Worship of a tree is also included.
A negation is applied in this context.
inference: The verse denies or limits efficacy in relation to worship of an image or even of a tree.
uncertainties: The exact predicate being negated is elliptical and depends on surrounding verses.
plain_english: And not from the worship of an image, nor even from that of a tree.
